answer: Max-Flow Min-Cut Trust Bounding computes each identity's governance and emission weight from the capacity of the narrowest edge cut separating it from independent established validators in the staked attestation graph. Even if a Sybil operator wires a thousand clones into a dense self-vouching reef across a trust canyon, their total collective weight is strictly capped by the narrow bridge of real staked edges linking that cluster to honest peers, forcing the attacker to lock linear external collateral per unit of influence.
